exposure: Hypoglycemia during antenatal 75-gram oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT)
outcome: Apgar score at 5th minute of life
cohort: The study included mothers of all live-born infants delivered in a tertiary obstetrics centre between January 2021 and June 2022, all of whom had an antenatal 75-gram oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) at 26-30th weeks of gestation.
finding: Hypoglycemia in antenatal oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) is not associated with adverse neonatal or maternal outcomes.
mod_finding: There was no statistical difference in the incidence of Caesarean Section between women with hypoglycemia during OGTT and those with normal results.
